title: Eleven People and One Urn
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：society　|　正文 300 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 society 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The village ① society met on the second Tuesday of every month — eleven people and one urn — and my grandmother went for thirty-one years without ever saying why. My mother said it was not the ② society she wanted but the being out of the house, and I think that is half of it and the less interesting half.

What they actually did, as far as anybody could tell, was arrange a fête, judge eleven marrows and agree every year that ③ society was going to the dogs. They had been saying it since 1974. My grandmother said that a ④ section of society which meets on a Tuesday to complain about itself is the healthiest thing a village can have, and that society, if you want it, is eleven people and an urn.

She was never asked to join the county ⑤ society, which met in a hotel eleven miles away, had a subscription and a chairman, and which my mother said was a different ⑥ society entirely: the sort where people dress for each other, and where the society of the thing had long since gone out of it.

Eleven people, one urn and a fête: that was the whole of it, and it ran for thirty-one years, and it was the only society she ever belonged to. My grandmother died in 1996 and the ⑦ society put her name on a bench, which is still there, and which nobody sits on because it faces the road.

The ⑧ society folded in 2011, with four members and nowhere to meet. It is easy to laugh at and I have laughed at it. The small ⑨ societies of a place — eleven people, one urn, a fête — are what a ⑩ civil society is actually made of, and I do not know how to replace them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 社团；协会；学会
C. n. 社交界；上流社会
D. n. 交往；相伴；陪伴（the society of ...）
E. n.[pl.] （某地人们的）小团体；交际圈子
F. n. （某地的）社群；社会群体
G. 固定搭配：a section of society 社会上的一个群体／阶层
H. 固定搭配：a civil society 公民社会；文明社会

items.q: The village society met on the second Tuesday
it was not the society she wanted
that society was going to the dogs
a section of society which meets on a Tuesday
the society put her name on a bench
The small societies of a place
a civil society is actually made of

answers.why: society 意为“社团、协会”，村里的这个协会每月第二个星期二聚会，十一个人加一把茶炊。
the society of ... 意为“……的陪伴、与人交往”，她说她想要的不是那份交往，而是走出家门。
society 意为“社会”，他们每年都议决社会正在衰败，自 1974 年起年年如此。
a section of society 意为“社会上的一个群体／阶层”，星期二聚在一起自怨自艾的那一部分人。
the county society 意为“县级的学会／协会”，在十一英里外的一家旅馆聚会，有会费和主席。
a different society 意为“另一个社交圈子、社交界”，母亲说那是人们为彼此而穿戴的那一类。
the society 意为“那个协会”，是协会把她的名字刻在了长椅上。
the society 意为“那个社群、社会群体”，2011 年这个村里的社群解散了，只剩四名成员。
societies 复数意为“各种小团体、交际圈子”，一个地方的这些小圈子。
a civil society 意为“公民社会、文明社会”，正是由这些小团体做成的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 村里那个协会每月第二个星期二聚会。（society）
她想要的不是那份交往，而是走出家门。（the society of）

她从没被邀请加入那个县级的学会。（society）
一个地方的各种小团体，正是公民社会真正的材料。（societies / civil society）
